title: South Pier Park Drive closes, 6 AM
text: Front Beach Road to L C Hilton Jr Drive, while the finish area and IRONMAN Village go up. It reopens Sunday, November 8 at noon.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: IRONMAN Village opens at Aaron Bessant Park
text: Free and open to everyone for several days before the race: athlete check-in, briefings, gear pickup and the official store.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Practice swim at Russell-Fields Pier
text: Athletes get one last swim in the Gulf before race morning.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Front Beach Road and West Park Drive close
text: Front Beach Road from West Park Drive to Powell Adams Road, and West Park Drive from Front Beach Road to Pier Park Drive.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: Swim start at Russell-Fields Pier
text: Two loops around the pier, starting at sunrise (about 6 AM).
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Bike course delays begin
text: Pier Park Drive to Philip Griffitts Sr Parkway until 11 AM, while athletes ride out.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: Runners on Front Beach Road
text: Two loops along the beach and through neighborhoods. The leaders finish in the afternoon.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Finish line closes
text: The last hours at Pier Park are the loudest of the day. IRONMAN's standard time limit is 17 hours; the athlete guide has the exact cutoffs.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Front Beach Road and West Park Drive reopen
text: South Pier Park Drive follows at noon.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: Swim
text: Two loops around Russell-Fields Pier in the Gulf, with a short run across the sand between loops.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Bike
text: One loop out of Pier Park along the Intracoastal Waterway and coastal back roads. Mostly flat, with some rolling stretches and wind that can build through the day.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Run
text: Two loops along the shoreline and through beach neighborhoods, finishing under the lights at Pier Park.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Sunrise swim start
text: The beach on both sides of Russell-Fields Pier. Get there before 6 AM.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Transitions
text: Transition areas give a close-up look as athletes change from swim to bike and bike to run.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: Front Beach Road
text: The run is two loops, so you can see your athlete twice from the same spot.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: The finish at Pier Park
text: Music and lights all evening, up to the midnight cutoff.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: IRONMAN Village
text: Aaron Bessant Park, free and open to everyone during race week.
source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

title: South Pier Park Drive is closed all week
text: From Nov 1 at 6 AM to noon Nov 8. Reach Pier Park from Panama City Beach Parkway or North Pier Park Drive.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: Front Beach Road on race day
text: Closed from West Park Drive to Powell Adams Road, 2 AM Saturday to 4 AM Sunday. Use Panama City Beach Parkway (US 98) to get around it.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: Bike course delays
text: From 6:30 to 11 AM Saturday, expect delays on Pier Park Drive up to Philip Griffitts Sr Parkway as cyclists ride out.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026

title: Plan ahead
text: Allow extra travel time and expect heavy event traffic near Pier Park. Park once and walk in on race morning.
source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026
